decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 11th September 2006 when the use shall cease
Condition : 2 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - 2.	The use shall be carried on only by the Trustees of the Shree Jalaram Seva Trust.  When the premises cease to be occupied by the Trustees of the Shree Jalaram Seva Trust or on the 11th September 2006, whichever shall first occur, the use hereby permitted shall cease and the portacabin and all other equipment brought onto the premises in connection with the use shall be removed.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for prayer hall purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 9.00am to 11.00pm, Monday to Saturday and 9.00am to 10.00pm Sunday.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed  without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and the details shall be submitted within two (2) months of this consent.
Condition : 7 - The four (4) parking spaces shown on Drawing No. MSB/P2/03/02/HUS2, dated Feb 03, receivied shall be available for use at all times and shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 8 - The hall and side doors to the building (including the extension and portable building) shall remain closed at all times when the building is in use.
Condition : 9 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used within the building
Condition : 10 - No external system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used.
Condition : 11 - All openings on the building facade, which overlook the back gardens to properties in Gloucester Road, shall be blocked up.

Condition : 12 - No activity shall be carried out outside the existing buildings on the site.  Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside these buildings on certain festival days or for other activities, prior permission shall be obtained from Council.

Condition : 13 - A list of festival days shall be submitted to the Council within one (1) month of consent being issued, indicating activities to be undertaken and means to mitigate against potential harm to residents. Traffic management measures shall be included
Condition : 14 - An efficient and effective extraction system should be maintained at all times to deal with cooking odours so that no odour is detectable outside the premises boundary.
description: Continued use of detached outbuilding as prayer hall, retention of single storey infill extension, extractor duct and portacabin.
